title: Hoshino Ichika — Escape By Sea〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi! Morning!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The field trip was so much fun!
I was talking to my mom about Yokohama the whole night after I got home♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did the same thing when I gave my parents their souvenirs. I told them about how I went on the water taxi with Kiritani and all that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Time out, Ichi! You're supposed to call her by her first name!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...that's right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm so used to calling her by her last name that it's a bit hard to just switch—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning, Kiritani—oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Whistle*
You called her by her last name again! You get a yellow card, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Grimace*
That's what I was saying before. It's just reflex...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even if we agreed to switch, it does take some time to get used to it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But still, it does make me happy to call each other by our first names... I'll try my best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm. If it's just about getting used to it, then why don't we play a game to help with that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? A game?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Before speaking, you first say the other person's name, and then the person who is spoken to will say your name after they reply.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And you're not allowed to slip up or forget to call them by their first name♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That sounds interesting. Okay, I guess it'd go something like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ichika, the field trip was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, uh...yes. I was just talking to Saki about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, her name! Don't forget her name!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Oh...Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There we go! That's the spirit!
Alright, now you try starting Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haruka... The weather's really nice today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It really is, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ichika, have you given your family their souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Mom and Dad really liked them. It was worth spending all of that time picking them out with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Saki, you said that you couldn't stop talking about Yokohama with your mom yesterday, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm! From when we were on the way to after we got there, I told her about everything♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I had so much to say that she ended up listening and chatting with me even after dinner, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Even Saki is sticking to the rules...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Haruka, what about you?
Did you talk to your family about the trip?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I did. And when I gave them the souvenir sailor penguin chocolates we saw after we got off the water taxi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My mom said that she had actually seen them before when she went to Yokohama with her friends a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? So that means they must be pretty popular.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She also said that she's been friends with them ever since.
So, this is a bit of a strange segue, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here, I'd like you two to have some.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow!!! Does that mean if we eat these, our friendship will be forever lasting?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not like they actually ate these, so this is just a token of sorts...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even so, that makes me happy. I also want to be closer friends with you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We should get to our seats. See you—

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh! Wait, Haruka! You too, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you two like to eat lunch together, the three of us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like that. Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm! Let's have lunch together♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, thanks for suggesting that game. I think I've gotten the hang of calling Haruka by her first name now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're very welcome♪
